description_en: Deletes a virus file record that failed to be handled. Only records with a handling action of Fail can be deleted. This operation does not delete the actual file on the user's endpoint device
description_zh: 删除一条处置失败的病毒文件记录。仅支持删除处置动作为Fail的记录，不会删除用户终端设备上的实际文件
kebab_example: aliyun csas delete-virus-file --dev-tag 36efa42d-2c32-c4dc-e3fc-8541e33a0000 --file-path C:_Users_Public_Downloads_setup.exe --file-md5 d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVirusFile

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the user's endpoint device where the virus file is located. The value can be up to 64 characters in length. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件所在用户终端设备的唯一标识。长度不超过64个字符。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: dev_tag

parameters.help_en:
The full path of the virus file on the user's endpoint device. Only records with a handling action of Fail can be deleted. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件在用户终端设备上的绝对路径。仅处置动作为Fail的记录可被删除。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en:
The MD5 value of the virus file. The value must be a 32-character hexadecimal string. You can obtain the value from the following operation:
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~): lists virus file statuses
parameters.help_zh:
病毒文件的MD5值，必须为32位十六进制字符。取值来源：
[ListVirusFileStatuses](~~ListVirusFileStatuses~~)：批量查询病毒文件状态
parameters.name: file_md5
